title: What Gift Tax Redesigns Is
definition: Gift Tax Redesigns: tax systems recognizing gift economies.
description:
Gift Tax Redesigns: tax systems recognizing gift economies. This is Post-Scarcity Economy at its most ambitious — gift ledgers research, redesign logistics engineering and valuation operations converging on a single goal: making redesign hulls real.

Why it matters: Post-Scarcity Economy will decide enforcement outcomes this century. Gift Tax Redesigns is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working redesign hulls, the larger gift ledgers vision stalls, and with it, the redesign logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Gift Tax Redesigns in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

t: Real Research Today: Gift Tax Redesigns
title: Real Research Today: Gift Tax Redesigns
definition: Today's documented research behind Gift Tax Redesigns.
description:
The road to Gift Tax Redesigns is already being paved. Kenya's GiveDirectly UBI trials and Stockton's SEED program tested basic income at city scale. Quadratic funding (Gitcoin) has distributed $60M+ to public goods via matching markets.

Time-banking networks (TimeBanks USA) trade hours as currency in hundreds of communities. Together these programs form the gift ledgers foundation that Gift Tax Redesigns will build on — the redesign logistics results, the valuation methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as redesign logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Gift Tax Redesigns
definition: Estimates Gift Tax Redesigns readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Gift Tax Redesigns components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a redesign hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Gift Tax Redesigns Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Gift Tax Redesigns: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Gift Tax Redesigns — tax systems recognizing gift economies.

Phase 1 — Prove (gift ledgers): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (redesign logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (valuation): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (enforcement): redesign hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and nations-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
